## Revised recommendation

Start the first newly specified method with **one observation, separate array
maps, raw ordinary MAP feedback and an explicitly specified map-to-sample
projection**. Here “naive” means SCI-MAP's ordinary positive-coefficient,
one-containing-pixel normalized estimator. It does not mean that a software
option or numerical implementation is already approved.

The sidebar correctly separates recovering the historical control from choosing
the first successor. My r0.1 JINC-first recommendation gave historical continuity
too much weight. That recommendation is withdrawn and superseded by this
proposal. The historical JINC control, its source/configuration facts and the
complete r0.1 packet remain unchanged. The original-measured-parent and
complete-replacement-map candidate recurrence need not change with the forward
mapmaker; both remain explicit pending method choices.

A matched piecewise-constant feedback projection offers a transparent
conditional example: on supported pixels, the restored applied model bins
back to itself, leaving the model plus binned cleaned residual. Forward naive
mapmaking alone does not select that projection. The
[sidebar disposition](SIDEBAR_DISPOSITION.md) gives the exact assumptions,
model-role distinction and limits. No unit sky response, convergence,
independent noise or useful source recovery follows from that identity.

Ordinary MAP still needs an exact PTC MAP-facing coefficient family, an admitted
numerical support policy including `coverage_cut`, an authorized rejoined-signal
handoff, and any selector-required companions. Those gaps remain explicit.
JINC's signed-kernel/projection round trip becomes a later separate method
specialization; its scientific contract is not reopened.
